svg.title: Interlinea a confronto
svg.desc: Original educational diagram. Genuine glyph outlines shaped with HarfBuzz from DM Sans and/or Roboto Serif, SIL OFL 1.1. No font substitution, horizontal scaling or clipping. Only the explicitly labelled simulated italic applies a geometric shear. Source fonts, hashes, locations and text runs are recorded in manifest.json. External editorial caption and rights are not embedded.

g.aria-label: Uguali: testo, font, corpo e giustezza
